name: angeo/module-aeo-brand-visibility
description: Live AI brand visibility audit for Magento 2. v2 measures REAL AI search (grounded mode: OpenAI web_search, Gemini Google Search grounding, Claude web search) not just training recall, reports share of voice against named competitors, samples each prompt N times for stable trend points, and lets third-party providers plug in via di.xml.

suggest.angeo/module-llms-txt: Publish llms.txt to improve brand recall in AI training pipelines.
suggest.angeo/module-rich-data: Improve Organization + Product schema to strengthen entity recognition.
suggest.angeo/module-openai-description-updater: Improve product content quality to increase AI citation rate.
